name: sure_vl_trl_vl_calibration_reference_v1

prompt.style: VL-Calibration structured vision and reasoning then boxed answer
prompt.visual_fact_encoding: JSON object in <vision> using predeclared slot keys
prompt.conditional_answer_confidence_event: answer correct given all required visual facts correct

implementation_notes: VL-Calibration requests 0-10 visual and reasoning scores; Sure-VL uses 0-100 visual and conditional-answer reports with its existing reward semantics.
The published dataset has no predeclared fact annotations or clear/restricted image pairs; train_path and validation_path remain unset until those are prepared and frozen.
The paper reports max_pixels=1000000; official code config uses 4194304. This reference chooses the published paper value.

The official launcher points at separate train.jsonl and val.jsonl placeholders, but both use the Hugging Face train split selector; prepare independent Sure-VL splits rather than copying those paths.
reference_policy_kl_coef is the official policy/reference KL setting, not Sure-VL's student/privileged-teacher distillation coefficient.
